criteria.text: Only a necessary-before needs choice may create a dependency in the supplied direction; other classifications do not automatically become dependencies.
An explicitly selected existing Class parent may receive the selected sub-issue; an explicit duplicate is marked with verified native readback.
Existing links, human removals, graph cycles, ownership, incomplete observations and uncertain mutation outcomes are respected.

cases.given: A validated needs proposal explicitly selects a dependent and necessary blocker
cases.required_observation: The native dependency is created in the selected direction only after existing graph and ownership checks.

cases.given: A validated explicit sub-issue choice names an existing Class parent
cases.required_observation: The selected child is linked through the existing native pathway with readback.

cases.given: A validated duplicate choice names endpoints and direction
cases.required_observation: The duplicate issue receives the documented comment and a matching complete timeline readback confirms the selected canonical issue.

cases.given: Self link, cycle, unknown graph, live foreign owner or confirmed human removal
A mutation has an unknown result
cases.required_observation: The batch stops and does not blindly resend; confirmed earlier results remain visible.

cases.given: Five classifications each explicitly choose none
cases.required_observation: All five are retained with no dependency writes.

cases.given: A needs effect reverses the agent supplied dependent and blocker
cases.required_observation: Only the supplied direction is eligible; the inverse is never written.

cases.given: An effect names an unrelated endpoint or itself
A human unmarks a previously marked duplicate
cases.required_observation: The duplicate remains unmarked and is not recreated.

cases.given: The duplicate comment POST outcome is unknown
cases.required_observation: The batch stops and retry uses readback only, with no second POST.

cases.given: The duplicate timeline pagination is incomplete
cases.required_observation: No success is claimed and no POST is repeated.

cases.given: The selected link is already present
cases.required_observation: It is reported already present and no mutation is sent.
